<script>
(function () {
  const searchInput = document.querySelector("#news-search");
  const tagSelect = document.querySelector("#news-tag");
  const status = document.querySelector("#news-status");
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#news-timeline .timeline-item"));

  function render() {
    const query = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const tag = tagSelect.value;
    let visible = 0;

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const matchesQuery = !query || item.dataset.search.includes(query);
      const matchesTag = !tag || item.dataset.tags.split("|").includes(tag);
      const show = matchesQuery && matchesTag;
      item.hidden = !show;
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });

    status.textContent = visible + " update" + (visible === 1 ? "" : "s");
  }

  items.forEach((item) => {
    const button = item.querySelector(".timeline-summary");
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const isOpen = item.classList.toggle("is-open");
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(isOpen));
    });
  });

  searchInput.addEventListener("input", render);
  tagSelect.addEventListener("change", render);
  render();
})();
</script>
